verdict.rationale: Anrok documents certificate upload via UI and API and pre-creating customers so certificates are searchable before billing, plus a marketing line 'Certificates collected, verified, and stored.' However there is no evidence of expiry tracking or of certificates being automatically applied at calculation time (the calc/transaction endpoints described don't mention certificate-based exemption logic). Missing for 10: expiry/renewal tracking, explicit automatic exemption application in the calculation API, and customer-facing self-serve collection workflow.
